en.headline: Police hunt man who snatched gold necklace from Tai Po jewellery store
en.dek: A man in his forties asked to try on a necklace worth nearly HK$80,000 at a Chow Sang Sang shop before fleeing on an airport-bound bus on Wednesday afternoon.
body: Police are searching for a man who snatched a gold necklace from a jewellery store in Tai Po on Wednesday afternoon.

According to a source, the suspect, described as a man in his forties, entered the Chow Sang Sang shop on Kwong Fuk Road around 3.10pm. After asking to try on the necklace, which weighed more than a tael, he snatched it and fled towards Kwong Fuk Lane before boarding an airport-bound bus.
Initial investigations indicated the suspect did not appear to be armed and no property was damaged. Police have classified the case as theft and are following up.

zh.headline: 警方通緝大埔珠寶店掠走金頸鏈男子
zh.dek: 一名約四十歲男子周三下午在廣福道周生生店舖要求試戴近八萬元金頸鏈後掠走，並登上往機場巴士逃走。
body: 警方正在通緝一名在大埔珠寶店掠走金頸鏈的男子。
據消息人士，涉案男子約四十歲，周三下午約三時十分進入廣福道周生生店舖，要求試戴一條重逾一兩的金頸鏈後掠走，逃往廣福里並登上往機場巴士。
初步調查顯示疑犯似乎並無攜帶武器，現場亦無財物損毀。警方將案件列作盜竊，正跟進調查。
